summary: TASK-017: Analytics Platform Integrations - COMPLETED. Implemented comprehensive analytics integration system with support for Google Analytics 4, Mixpanel, and Amplitude. Created base analytics interface with event tracking, revenue analysis, user analytics, funnel analysis, and cohort analysis capabilities. Added unified reporting module for cross-platform data aggregation and ROI tracking.
current_status: TASK-017 implementation complete. All three platform integrations (GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude) implemented with base abstract class and unified analytics wrapper.
next_steps: Test analytics integrations with actual API credentials
Create analytics tests in tests/ directory
Add analytics integration to frontend UI
Document analytics setup in project README
blockers: API credentials required for GA4 (GA4_PROPERTY_ID, GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH or GA4_CREDENTIALS_JSON)
API credentials required for Mixpanel (MIXPANEL_PROJECT_ID, MIXPANEL_API_SECRET)
API credentials required for Amplitude (AMPLITUDE_API_KEY, AMPLITUDE_SECRET_KEY)
Optional: Install google-analytics-data package for GA4 support: pip install google-analytics-data
Optional: Install requests package for HTTP API calls: pip install requests

acceptance_criteria.google_analytics_4: Implemented - supports events, conversions, revenue, user properties via GA4 Data API
acceptance_criteria.mixpanel_integration: Implemented - supports events, cohorts, funnels, retention via Mixpanel API
acceptance_criteria.amplitude_integration: Implemented - supports events, user profiles, cohorts, experiments via Amplitude API
acceptance_criteria.unified_reporting: Implemented - UnifiedAnalytics class aggregates data across all platforms
acceptance_criteria.roi_tracking: Implemented - ROIMetrics class calculates ROI/ROAS with ad spend attribution

subtasks.TASK-017-01: COMPLETED - Created analytics base with abstract AnalyticsPlatform class defining interface for events, revenue, users, funnels, and cohorts
subtasks.TASK-017-02: COMPLETED - Implemented all 3 platforms: GA4 (ga4.py), Mixpanel (mixpanel.py), Amplitude (amplitude.py)

key_features.event_tracking: All platforms support track_event() and track_events_batch() methods
key_features.revenue_attribution: get_revenue() returns RevenueData with total, by source, by campaign breakdown
key_features.user_analytics: get_user_count() and get_user_profile() for user metrics and profiles
key_features.funnel_analysis: get_funnel_analysis() returns conversion funnels with step-by-step metrics
key_features.cohort_analysis: get_cohort_analysis() for retention cohort analysis across time periods

base_classes: AnalyticsPlatform (ABC) - Abstract base defining platform interface
AnalyticsEvent - Event data model with properties and revenue
AnalyticsUser - User profile with sessions, revenue, cohorts
RevenueData - Revenue metrics with transaction counts and attribution
FunnelStep - Single funnel step with conversion metrics
FunnelAnalysis - Complete funnel with overall conversion rate
CohortData - Cohort analysis with retention by period
platform_implementations: GoogleAnalytics4 - GA4 Data API integration (read-only, use Measurement Protocol for tracking)
MixpanelAnalytics - Mixpanel API with import API for events, query API for analytics
AmplitudeAnalytics - Amplitude HTTP API V2 for tracking, Chart API for analytics
unified_analytics: UnifiedAnalytics - Aggregates data from all enabled platforms
CrossPlatformRevenue - Unified revenue metrics across platforms
CrossPlatformUsers - Unified user metrics with overlap estimation
PlatformComparison - Platform variance analysis and recommendations
ROIMetrics - ROI/ROAS calculation with ad spend attribution
configuration: AnalyticsConfig - Environment-based configuration for all platforms
Supports GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude credentials via .env file
Regional endpoints (US/EU) for Mixpanel and Amplitude
Cache and timeout settings for API calls

usage_examples.platform_factory: from integrations.analytics import get_analytics_platform; ga4 = get_analytics_platform('ga4')
usage_examples.unified_factory: from integrations.analytics import get_unified_analytics; unified = get_unified_analytics()

integration_notes.ga4: GA4 Data API is read-only. For event tracking, use Google Analytics Measurement Protocol separately. Supports service account authentication.
integration_notes.mixpanel: Supports both event tracking (via Import API) and analytics queries. Regional endpoints for EU compliance.
integration_notes.amplitude: HTTP API V2 for event ingestion, Chart API for analytics queries. Signature-based authentication with API key + secret.
integration_notes.unified: Automatically initializes all enabled platforms. Provides platform comparison with variance detection and recommendations.
